description: This file defines types and interfaces for a conversation store used in MS Teams proactive messaging. It includes type definitions for conversation reference objects, store entry, and store methods for managing conversations such as upserting, retrieving, listing, removing, and finding conversations by user ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Adds or updates a conversation reference associated with a conversation ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Finds the most recent personal DM conversation reference for a specific user ID.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Deprecated method for finding conversation reference by user ID; use findPreferredDmByUserId instead.
